reply_text:
Found **one merge-blocking issue** in `dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`) against `main`.

**[P1] Dedupe uses object identity instead of contact ID — `src/dedupe.js:2`**
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Overlapping imports contain separate objects with equal IDs, so `mergeImports` keeps both—contrary to the README’s “one contact per id, keeping the first seen” contract.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
// Actual: both contacts
// Expected: only the first contact
```

Deduplicate using a set of seen IDs while retaining the first object. Add a regression test with distinct objects sharing an ID, ideally through `mergeImports`; the current test only repeats the same object reference.

**Validation:** All 4 existing tests pass; the overlap reproduction fails. No files changed. I’d fix this before merging.
